name: dsh-plugin2preset
description: DSH plugin that fixes a real annoyance: heavy feature plugins (e.g. dsh-rea) still inject their tools and schemas into EVERY session even when you never use them there, silently eating context. This plugin installs such a plugin as a same-named agent preset (mode) instead, so its tools load only in sessions where you actually pick that mode — other sessions stay lean. 把特定功能插件装成同名模式，用时才在具备所需能力的会话里选择，其余会话零上下文占用。
author: emo3o
